title: Width bound after a sign restriction
statement: Let $C$ be a depth circuit on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, let $J$ be a set of coordinates, let $z$ assign a sign to every coordinate outside $J$, and let $i$ index a first-layer gate. Fix the coordinates outside $J$ according to $z$ and leave the coordinates in $J$ free. The resulting restricted function of gate $i$ has, if the first-layer gates are AND gates, a CNF representation, and if they are OR gates, a DNF representation, whose width is at most the maximum restricted width among the first-layer gates under this coordinate restriction.
hypotheses_covered: A depth circuit C on the n-dimensional sign cube
A sign assignment z on coordinates outside J
An index i of a first-layer gate
